title: Global integral lattices for lisse sheaves on smooth geometric fibres
statement: Let $K_0\subseteq K$ be fields, let $T_0$ be a smooth separated finite-type $K_0$-scheme [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and put $T=T_0\times_{K_0}K$ [def-pc-base-change]. Let $\ell$ be a prime invertible in $K_0$, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite with valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and on $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] put $B_T=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/\varpi^n)_T$ and $E_T=B_T[1/\varpi]$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. For every $E_T$-module sheaf $L$ which is pro-etale locally finite free [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], there is a $B_T$-submodule sheaf $M\subseteq L$, pro-etale locally finite free, such that the inclusion induces an isomorphism $M[1/\varpi]\xrightarrow{\sim}L$. The ranks may vary between components and may be zero; the empty scheme is included.

source.place: Lemmas 7.4.7 and 7.4.10, pp. 70-71, and Proposition 6.8.4(1),(4), pp. 59-60; geometric input: Stacks varieties.tex Tag 056T (lemma-smooth-geometrically-normal), morphisms.tex Tag 01VB (lemma-base-change-smooth), properties.tex Tag 0BQ3 (lemma-normal-geometrically-unibranch). Compact profinite monodromy admits an integral lattice.
